run_hydra_app: run the hydra app my_app that prints the resolved config as YAML
run_hydra_sweep: run the hydra app with sweep mode to iterate over multiple config combinations
review_hydra_config_printing: review the my_app function that uses OmegaConf.to_yaml to print the Hydra config
refactor_hydra_main_decorator: refactor the hydra.main decorator to change the config_path or config_name values
test_hydra_app_config: test the my_app function by running it with different Hydra config overrides via CLI
